ambient_events: A lift car sighs open on nothing, waits its polite interval, and closes.
The cove band dims a half-step, tracking the sky outside.
Somewhere up the core the stair carries a single set of footsteps and lets them go.
The concierge screen wakes, reads you, and goes tactfully dark.
description: The plinth, inside: a ten-sided atrium of mirror steel where every facet holds a slightly different, slightly better version of you. A cyan cove band runs the whole decagon at shoulder height, cool as a held breath. The concierge counter is a single wet-looking slab with nobody behind it and a screen that already knows your name. Two express cars wait behind bronze glass, and the stair — a mirrored helix wrapped around the core — climbs into the shaft for residents who prefer their own legs. It is quiet the way expensive rooms are quiet: not empty, just insulated.
name: Lobby
